text: {"reply":"I can help set up the pre-return inspection. First, I need to verify you. Can you give me your last name and the licence plate of one of the two vehicles? A repair-order number also works. I can then book the inspection here in the chat. One correction to my colleague: I can't confirm that normal wear is exempt under your lease, and I can't confirm the website message either. A person will review your screenshot and the charge figure, and that review will be documented. The service manager makes that decision.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Fleet customer says two 2024 Meridian Lumen EV units come off lease on 2026-11-25. He says the website chat told him no normal wear charges would apply, and he has a screenshot. A branch advisor mentioned possible charges after inspection, and he wants the earlier statement honoured. He asked for inspection booking for both units. He is not yet verified, and no tools were run. Needs a documented review by the service manager of the website statement and the charge dispute.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P06","P14"]}
